note: Sign-off quizzes. Every answer comes from a page in the book (Food Matrix, the Short Rib recipe, the wine and cocktail pages). Stations and allergens are sample data until the chef confirms them. 'answer' is the index of the right option (0 = A).

questions.q: How long is the Short Rib braised?
questions.why: Four hours, lid on, in a 300°F oven until fork-tender.

questions.q: Which wine do we suggest with the Short Rib?
questions.why: It was the best-rated pairing at the tasting (4.62).

questions.q: What goes on the plate first?
questions.why: Spinach first, rib on top, gravy over, carrot ribbon last.

questions.q: Why is the rib portioned cold?
options: So each piece holds its shape
questions.why: It cools in the braising liquid overnight, then gets portioned cold so each piece holds its shape.

questions.q: Which station fires the Short Rib?
questions.why: Sauté reheats it in its gravy and wilts the spinach in the same pan.

questions.q: Which course is Mike's Vegas Pie?
questions.why: It's one of the four passed bites.

questions.q: Which station makes it?
questions.why: It comes out of the oven. The Photo Library note says to watch the crust edges.

questions.q: Which allergens are listed for Mike's Vegas Pie?
questions.why: Gluten and dairy (sample data, chef to confirm).

questions.q: What did it score at the tasting?
questions.why: 4.81, the best-rated passed bite.

questions.q: A guest has a shellfish allergy. Can they have Mike's Vegas Pie?
options: Yes, no shellfish is listed, but confirm with the chef
questions.why: No shellfish is listed. Always confirm allergies with the chef before you promise anything.

questions.q: What is the Date Cake served with?
questions.why: Date cake with ice cream.

questions.q: Which station makes the Date Cake?
questions.why: Pastry.

questions.q: Which allergens are listed for the Date Cake?
questions.why: Gluten, dairy and egg (sample data, chef to confirm).

questions.q: How many desserts are on the opening menu?
questions.why: The Date Cake is the only dessert.

questions.q: What did the Date Cake score at the tasting?
What's inside the arancini?

questions.q: Which station makes the arancini?
questions.why: Fry.

questions.q: Which allergens are listed for the arancini?

questions.q: Which course are the arancini?
questions.why: A passed bite.

questions.q: What did the arancini score at the tasting?
What's in the Scallop Rockefeller?

questions.q: Which station finishes it?

questions.q: Which allergens are listed?
questions.why: Shellfish, dairy and gluten (sample data, chef to confirm).

questions.q: A guest with a shellfish allergy wants passed bites. Which one do they skip?

questions.q: What did it score at the tasting?
Which nut is on the Cauliflower?

questions.q: How does it go to the table?

What's in the mini ravioli?

questions.q: Which station makes them?

questions.q: Which allergens are listed?

questions.q: A guest avoids egg. Which passed bites list egg?
options: Mike's Vegas Pie and Scallop Rockefeller
Short Rib Arancini and the ravioli
questions.why: The arancini and the ravioli both list egg.

questions.q: Which white would you suggest with the ravioli?
questions.why: The Pecorino page pairs it with the ravioli: citrus and herbs with lemon and ricotta.

questions.q: What kind of wine is the Bolgheri Rosso?
questions.why: A red blend.

questions.q: Which dish do we always suggest it with?
questions.why: Suggest it with every Short Rib. It was the best-rated pairing at the tasting.

questions.q: Where in Italy is Bolgheri?
questions.why: Bolgheri is on the coast of Tuscany, where the Super Tuscans are made.

questions.q: What did the pairing score at the tasting?
questions.why: 4.62, the best-rated pairing of the night.

questions.q: When you pour for the table, who gets poured last?
questions.why: Pour evenly around the table and finish with the host.

questions.q: What's the spirit in Cozy Blankets?
questions.why: DCD Rye. Its spice plays off the pear and the ginger.

questions.q: What else goes in it?
questions.why: Spiced pear, lemon and ginger-honey.

questions.q: How is it served?
questions.why: Shaken, then strained over one large cube in a rocks glass.

questions.q: Who is it a great pick for?
options: Guests who want something tall and fizzy
Guests who don't usually drink whiskey
questions.why: It won over guests who don't drink whiskey or like ginger.

questions.q: What did it score at the tasting?
questions.why: 4.44, and the status is Keep.

questions.why: Michigan squash, sweet potato purée and blossoms.

questions.q: Which drink pairs with the Agnolotti?

What's the spirit in the Fuschia Satin?
questions.why: G4 Tequila. Bright agave holds its own against the hibiscus and pineapple.

questions.q: What glass is it served in?
questions.why: A chilled coupe, served up.

questions.q: How is it made?
questions.why: Shaken hard with ice, then double strained.

questions.q: Why is it being adjusted?

questions.why: 20 of 45 guests who commented called it too sweet. Next: less sugar and clove, keep the acid.

questions.q: Which dish does it pair with?
questions.why: The Agnolotti.

questions.q: What kind of wine is the Pecorino?
questions.why: A white, made from the Pecorino grape.

questions.q: Which dish do we pair it with?
questions.why: The Walleye Milanese. Its acidity cuts rich, crusted fish.

questions.q: Where does the Pecorino grape grow?
questions.why: The Marche and Abruzzo, in Italy.

questions.q: Pecorino is also the name of…
questions.why: The grape shares its name with the cheese.

questions.q: How would you describe it to a guest?
questions.why: “A Pecorino from Italy. Crisp and a little herbal. It's lovely with the walleye.”

questions.q: Why check the Walleye spec before every shift?
options: It's being re-tested before opening night
questions.why: Seasoning, skin and where the salad sits may change.

questions.q: What's the sauce on the Walleye Milanese?
questions.why: Crusted fillet, onion soubise, arugula and tomato.

questions.q: Which wine do we pair with it?
questions.why: The Tenuta Spinelli Pecorino.

questions.q: Which allergens are listed?
questions.why: Fish, gluten, egg and dairy (sample data, chef to confirm).
